reference: Inkloom AI approved logo (the demo’s registered reference)
method: Twelve synthetic creatives drawn in code (backend/logo_eval.py), labelled before running. Each was sent once, with the approved reference logo, through the same logo comparison the product uses. AI output can differ between runs: this is one recorded run, and every miss is listed. Separate from the rule-engine evaluation, which never uses AI.

tried_and_not_kept.change: Stricter comparison instructions: a match needs the same colours, proportions and wordmark spelling; rotated, blurred or cropped logos go to a person as uncertain.
tried_and_not_kept.outcome: Same score on the same 12 items, with the same two misses on altered logos, so the product keeps the original instructions (the ones behind the results above and the 51/51 live check).
